newsitem.title: CHINA: China nightclub fire kills 11 women.
newsitem.headline: China nightclub fire kills 11 women.

text.p: A fire roared through a south China nightclub early this month, killing 11 young women as locked doors and barred windows blocked their escape, local officials said on Friday.
The fire at the "Big Spender" nightclub in Anxiang county in Hunan province broke out in the early hours on December 4, trapping the women as they slept in an upstairs dormitory.
"The bodies were burned beyond recognition," said an official, adding that some were found lying near the nighclub's locked security door, installed to prevent theft.
All of the dead were nightclub hostesses, aged from 15 to 21.
Another county government official said the nightclub had been told by firemen to upgrade its safety facilities shortly before the blaze.
Five people from the club's management have been detained and the cause of the fire was still under investigation, officials said without giving further details.
